title: Hazel and the Drop
author: N. M. Blackwood
blurb: Felix Brightwater, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
